title: Marcos’ Singapore F1 invite to cost PH ‘almost no expense’ – envoy
summary: SINGAPORE — The Philippines will incur “almost no expense” from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s attendance at the Singapore Grand Prix, Philippine Ambassador to Singapore Medardo Macaraig said…

blocks.text: SINGAPORE — The Philippines will incur “almost no expense” from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s attendance at the Singapore Grand Prix, Philippine Ambassador to Singapore Medardo Macaraig said Wednesday. Macaraig said Marcos was invited to the Formula One event by Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and would not have to pay for a ticket if he attends. “Imbitasyon ‘yun ni Prime Minister Lawrence Wong. So ‘yun, siyempre, halos wala tayong gastos diyan,” Macaraig told reporters at the Philippine Embassy in Singapore. (That was an invitation from Prime Minister Lawrence Wong. So, of course, we will incur almost no expense from that.) READ: […]... Keep on reading: Marcos’ Singapore F1 invite to cost PH ‘almost no expense’ – envoy
